text: Went here with my family per a Tik Tok recommendation and it totally exceeded expectations! Food was delicious, dishes were so creative and flavorful, the service was fantastic and the food was super affordable. The outdoor seating had heat lamps and overall this place was just awesome. We will be back for sure!!

Wow! I've been curious about this little European deli for quite a while. So glad I finally made a point of checking it out. Only wish I'd gone sooner! The staff was so friendly and helpful. I'm unfamiliar with many of the deli foods they offer, and the young woman taking my order at the deli counter was very patient and kindly answered all my questions.

There are lots of imported goodies in the grocery sections. There are plenty of sweet and salty snacks, drinks, canned and prepackaged foods, and a nice selection of imported beers. The deli area is awesome! Delicious pastries, and fresh made deli foods like cheese blintzes and stuffed cabbage. Everything we ordered was absolutely delicious!

Food was good and we like the outdoor seating on nice nights.  Problem they let a chain smoker sit inside the patio area.  The smoke came to our table and destroyed our meal.  We left feeling like we needed a shower.   When I mentioned it to the manager he said he allows it because in past he lost a lot of smokers with the law change.  Well they have lost us. If we cannot enjoy a nice evening because he puts others right to smoke over our enjoyment of dinner, there other nice restaurants that don't.

This is my first update since the virus. This places very good! I like the idea of the buying everything through the phone and what not and the food was great, but the menu on the phone needs a better system more pictures for people like me that don't know the menu or the food, overall it was a good time!

I have been to the Mello Mushroom many times and the service and food has always been outstanding. But on my last visit Sunday 2/23, they went above and beyond their usual service. I always order anchovies on my pizza but they were out, much to my disappointment. The server told the manager what happened and by the time my pizza arrived they had sent someone out to get anchovies just to satisfy me. That is what exceptional customer service is all about! Needless to say, I will not consider going anywhere else to get my pizza.

Ale visitor for years for weekday/work lunch, weeknights and weekends. Pizzas are delicious, personally prefer handtossed, loads of toppings and definitely worth the cost due to such a fully loaded pizza. Wings are delicious. Lori has consistently been the best server for a weekday work lunch, she is consistently the most efficient, stays on top of the needs of the table for drinks, etc. and being time careful so we don't end up being late (especially when we work just around the corner).

We are from Houston and this place is fire!! I live in OroValley and I don't mind driving for good wings! We ordered the spicy wings and let me tell you I had to put my beer down and get a glass of milk to put out the fire in my mouth! Those were the best wings!!! I just wish they were regular wings!! There is no meat on these party wings anymore.  My husband woke up this morning still talking about those wings. I can't wait to go back!

We passed by this coffee house on our way to dinner and decided to stop in before we headed back home.  I'm so glad we did!

I love the atmosphere here.  It's a nice little place, relaxed atmosphere, and homey.

The staff is friendly and very helpful.

I ordered a blended Van Gogh's Milky Way, and it was delicious!  I wish we lived closer to this place, but I hope to stop by in again the next time we're in the area.

This is my new favorite restaurant to take friends, family andVIP's when visiting Philadelphia.  Every time we walk in, we feel transported to another part of the world and the food just keeps us there wondering why we haven't tasted anything like this before. 

The staff from front to back are so well trained and attentive in just the right way. The seem to appear just when you need them with just what you want.

This place is a new Philadelphia gem!!!

Besides from being impossible to eat without getting dirty. It wasn't half bad. There seems to be a better system to refilling drinks though. If your wearing the plastic gloves given with utensils your not going to want to grab your drink and hand it to the server and get food all over it. Kind of expensive for what you get but flavors were pretty good. Would like to have more than a half of corn on the cob per person instead of the potatoes. Looking forward to going back and trying something new.

Love their food and it tastes great most of the time however, The portions (pertaining to the kabob orders and not the kabobs themselves but the sides) seemed to have gotten smaller. Or at least it seems so every time I order out. Not sure if it's across the board with all Zoe's locations but with this one it has been a common occurrence for me.

Jim's is literally one of if not the best spot to get cheesesteak hands down . 

First and foremost, the place is CASH ONLY. With that being said; after tax it comes out to 9 dollars and change.  Afterwards, you heve the option of eating it on site either against the wall or going upstairs and grabbing a seat in their dining area. 

Secondly, the best way to order is a cheesesteak with the classic wiz and extra onions. Of course there is the option to add American or provolone instead but stick with the classic. 

Me and my friend literally drive from central Jersey after work just to go to Jim's to grab a bite if the craving hits us. Just goes to show how loyal and good this place is . Forget about all the rest. Jim's is just premier !

Went here on 10/23 at noon and had a coupon.  I specifically asked the girl making my sandwich if the daily sandwich for $6 could be included in the coupon.  She said yes or i wouldn't have ordered it.

The guy ringing up my meal including the coupon tried to charge me full price almost 30% more than it should have been.  

They didn't honor the price quoted and refused to make it right.  I left without paying and hungry.  To add insult the guy yelled "peace out!" to me on the way out.  Even though all i said to him "why would I pay more than i'm supposed to?"  He tried to act like he didn't know how to use the cash register.  

Be careful that they charge you the correct price as they either have no idea what they are doing or they are trying to manipulate the customers.  Incredibly rude service on top of mistakes and its a pretty crappy product anyways!
Service was slow.  The waiter was a nice guy but was not real attentive.  The food was good but price was high for what you received.  I like the Deco.

We grabbed some bbq for dinner last week. We got one of the family meals and had brisket, cornbread, potato salad, Mac and cheese, and cole slaw. We ordered the Texas heat and root beer bbq sauces but they left out the Texas heat. We didn't really like the root beer. Too sweet for us. 

The brisket was great though! We enjoyed the leftovers for days (hello breakfast tacos!).   The potato salad was my fav of the sides.  The Mac and cheese was very velveeta like and the cole slaw was wayyyyyyy too tart for my liking.  The cornbread was average IMO but my husband really liked it. 

I would definitely go back again but switch up the sides. The brisket was definitely the star of the meal!

Rented the top floor out for an event. The environment was intimate and we loved the outdoor balcony. I'm not into the Cajun stuff, so this was pretty much the only actual meal I had during my entire trip.

If it wasn't for the attentiveness our waiter provided us I would have given this review a 1 star. The food was so salty from the hot and sour soup to the steak pepper and general tso. Did the chef accidentally dump a whole salt container? There were four of us and we left hungry and thirsty.

A group of us came here on a Friday night for karaoke to celebrate for my birthday. The place is very small, limited seating, and smells like chicken grease so don't wear anything nice or a brand new wig, lol

The food is greasy bar food, and they are known for their amazing chicken wings and pizza. The place was packed and we Got there early so we could get a good seat. 

It was fun, but it's definitely the same crowd every week, and the same old local singers because everyone knew everybody. 

It gets packed pretty quick.

Looking for a new place for Chinese food as nothing we've had in Millwoods has been completely satisfying.  Tried this one on a whim and was happily surprised. Food was fresh, prices were good and everything was really tasty. I am still on a hunt for crushed almond chicken that has actual breading, not batter, theirs is the battered version but the flavour was very good.  My family found the dishes a bit too salty, but everything was great other than that. Their dinner for 4, 4 entrees plus soup, spring rolls and fried rice, was the same price as other places for 4 entrees alone. Plus free green onion cakes for over $39 order..great deal and tasty food.

Man oh man I loved this place. We went at the most crazy time of the day (Sunday right at brunch time right after a concert) and we still were there for less than an hour. The food was great, my husbands drink was delicious, and our waiter was amazing.

I absolutely love Italian food so I should have been in heaven.  Unfortunately I wasn't impressed.  While the service was good this place was a bit too noisy. 

But let's move on to the food.  The food was OK but nothing to get excited about.  I can't say that I won't ever go back again but maybe it will be at another location.

We were crazing a good ole burger after taking the kids to gym. This place is located about 5 miles from their gym. I ordered the Sriracha cha cha. Man was it delicious! The incorporate the sriracha into the meat before grilling it. It was just the right amount heat to where it was hot but not so hot you couldn't enjoy it. Everyone else with me enjoyed their food. One got the chili cheese burger and said it was amazing. I might have to try it next but I don't think I can pass up another chance to eat the sriracha cha cha burger. Fires are hand cut and fried perfectly. They give you a lot as well! We will definitely be back. Might be our new burger joint!

We were sat in the cocktail/bar area and waited a few minutes to be greeted. They seemed busy with Togo orders at the bar which resulted in Us waiting 10+ minutes for a wine and a whiskey drink. The food was super underwhelming. My Buffalo chicken wrap came out with a raw tortilla and was falling apart and my partners ribs were severely overcooked and burnt. The only redeeming aspect was the complimentary croissant, because if we had to pay for it, we would have been annoyed as it was semi stale and oily. For sure won't be back.

First I'm going to say I LOVE Hattie bs! BUT the past two times we have gone this location has not been. The girl taking our order (we are locals) was VERY condescending. You could also tell she did not want to be there. She was not friendly at all! The chicken looked like it was half dipped in medium sauce and my boyfriends chicken was gooey and looked a little under cooked. The lines suck in the one in midtown... but that one is the best.
The Floridian omelet was the BEST thing EVER! I highly recommend it! The mimosa was also fantastic. This was our first time here. I will definitely be back.

I loved this place!! Always been a fan of Luke Bryan so I had to check it out when I was visiting Nashville!! It exceeded my expectations! The live music was amazing,loved how the artists interacted with the crowd!The food and drinks were delicious also!

We've been meaning to come here for long time!We ordered a charcuterie board, and two glasses of wine. We thought there would be more of a wine selection, 3 types of wine isn't what we were expecting( A little expensive too for the quality at $11 a glass, we're winos) but we obliged and gave it a try anyway. The charcuterie board was a bit underwhelming for the price of $20. A big salad in the middle with no dressing. A side of Jam and Mustard, olives, sweet pickles, bread and crackers. The meat was amazing! The dry lettuce was a little confusing, but maybe that was what the jam was for? I'm not sure maybe we'll try something else next time. Great location, great atmosphere, but I guess we were expecting a little bit more.

We picked up Aya Sofia after a hankering for some Turkish cuisine one evening, and I am thoroughly impressed!!
We started with the baba ganoush, a smooth and tangy dip which came with the most delicious, fresh bread on the side. 
For entrees, we got the iskender, which was tender and flavorful, (Added bonus points for the amazing grilled tomato) and the musakka, which is basically  eggplant lasagna. The flavors were warm, herbaceous and so complex--I'm still thinking about it!!! 

To top it all off, we received a complimentary Turkish coffee chocolate sticky pudding, which was rich and deep and truly unlike anything I've ever tasted in my life. Absolutely divine. Can't wait to go back!

The server was fantastic!  Food was average a potatoes and Asparagus not seasoned well at all.  While snapper was cut in half instead of left while.  We had a $100 gift card that was indicated was for both This restaurant and its sister restaurant Flamestone. At the end of the meal, was told the gift card was not valid here at Beachwood.  Very disappointing after a very average meal. Manager came by with an excuse that their POS servers were not linked.  Sort it out. Will not be back.

The pizza is good, the garlic rolls garlicky, but what put this over the top to five stars are the wings. Crispy and delicious. I despise those moist, gooey on the inside, barely cooked wings you find at so many places. The Madison Avenue wings are cooked just right on the inside with a crispy, crunchy exterior. Perfect!

You know about the wings, but what about the pizza? It's good. I like Cristino's better, but when I don't feel like driving to Clearwater for pizza, this one is great and the best you'll find in Dunedin. Generous toppings, good crust. Bonus that they have great weekly specials which you won't find at other pizza places.

Now, let's talk about ordering. Online ordering is easy and completely transparent. I love that I can order just flats for the wings and that I know right away it's going to cost me $1 more. I love that I can order toppings on just half the pizza and get charged for just half the toppings.

If you haven't tried Madison Avenue Pizza yet, do yourself a favor and order soon. Or go in to their restaurant and treat yourself to wine or beer with your meal. You won't be disappointed.

We had food delivered for seven people, the first time any of us had ever tried S & S and all I kept thinking was, what took us so long! The ribs amazing, meaty and tender. Just perfect. We got two of the appetizers, deviled eggs and fried pickles both of which were tremendous. The sides of Mac and cheese and potato salad were both winners. If I have one small complaint it would be the size of the potato's in the salad, which were kind of big, but the flavor was still there. They accidentally (I think) gave us an order of pulled pork. Good move S & S! I'm not a huge pulled pork guy, but OMG this is the best I've ever had, hands down. Yeah, K.C. And Memphis get all the press as they've been doing great BBQ for years, but don't ever overlook St. Louis. The BBQ in this town is at least equal to anywhere in the country and I just might have found the best of the bunch.

We had a difficult time finding the restaurant .   There were a lot of potted plants around tit.    The food was very good .    Funny that the chicken tandoori was in the menu-- India was a colony and the food is popular in England.    We had the duck pate and salmon pate-   Nice presentation and a little salty.   The fish and chips and rabbit
Pie were excellent .   We had the fresh oysters which was fine but would go elsewhere.   
The men loved the beer on tap and was a great addition to the meal .   The service was good-- water was filled and cutlery was replaced appropriately, crumbs were removed before the dessert course.

Had a reservation for dinner with friends before a play at the Walnut Street Theatre. We ordered paella and many different tapas plates and really enjoyed sharing and sampling everything. The food was outstanding! The bread was impossible to keep on our table, as we all devoured it as soon as it arrived; it was insanely delicious. We were a bit concerned that the paella wouldn't come in time for us to enjoy before we had to leave to ensure we made it to the theater on time. It did, and we ate it quickly. Afterwards we had to jog to make it to the WST in time, but we didn't mind having to burn off the extra pieces of bread we'd all eaten. I look forward to going back.

I think I'm too used to the delicious LA brunch scene that this just did not live up to my expectations. We arrived there and waited less than five minutes before a table opened up. The two stars are for how friendly the server was.

I got the creole breakfast plate and lychee latte, and my friend got the seafood benedict. The breakfast plate was extraordinarily ordinary, and the boudin was more rice than meat. Grits were delicious but you can tell they put a heavy dose of butter in it. The lychee latte had a faint hint of lychee and mainly tasted of milk. My friend's crab cake tasted very delicious in small doses.

Festive atmosphere downtown with nice outside seating. Tends to be more bar feel but the chicken and sides were outstanding. Mac and cheese and greens were very tasty.  Brown sugar Bacon for starters was some of the best we have had. 
Not giving 5 stars due to the evening shift change bartenders were less than jovial. Lunch group was quite the opposite. Very upbeat and having fun 
Overall a good experience. Thanks Indy!

Petra is one of our takeout classics- we love it! I used to order the chicken kabob every time, but those take about 20 minutes to cook from the time you order them. I've started ordering the shawarma now. Similar enough to satisfy my cravings for the chicken kabob but it comes out much quicker. We always upgrade to the meal- it comes with fries and a drink (a soda or a water bottle from the fridge) for not that much more. 

The staff is always very friendly, and there is free water on the counter for while you wait. This inside is small, but it usually isn't busy. Last time we ate inside, but we also take it to-go pretty regularly. 

Very reasonably priced authentic food, and everything is very good.

Exceptional service and great food! My friend Kiara and I went for brunch on Sunday and received prompt service, and fantastic cocktails. Our server Nicole was a delight!  Very knowledgeable, and helpful in suggesting drinks. We will most definitely visit again soon. Best place in Channelside for drinks and sushi.

a truly beautiful space! st roch is one of the first food halls i ever went to a few years back. the natural light is incredible during the day and the room is gorgeous at night. all of the vendors have amazing food. it has a little bit everything. i'm not in this area often but when i am i love to visit.
This place is amazing, I travel all over the country for work and I love good seafood. This seriously good food!!!

Rating: 3.9 Stars

This was my first time at Uncle Bill's Pancake and Dinner House. I have heard a lot about this place--especially their late-night dining experience--and I wanted to give it a try for lunch. As you all know, I love pancakes so I figured that it was about time to give it a try. The restaurant did a good job of social distancing; they put up plexiglass separators between the booths. They also use plastic cutlery. Because I wanted to try the buttermilk pancakes and also wanted to try the buckwheat pancakes, I ordered both. I am from Pennsylvania, and I have not had buckwheat pancakes since my birthday brunch in December 2018 at Sqwires. Sadly, I don't have photos from that meal. I was not much of a (pancake) foodie then so I didn't take as many photographs as I should have. Anyway, back to Uncle Bill's. The service was fast, and my pancakes arrived quickly. The buttermilk pancakes were above average but nothing special. The buttermilk flavor was subtle. That being said, I can see the late-night appeal. The syrup was the least viscous syrup that I have had in a while, and it wasn't very sweet. After finishing the buttermilk pancakes, I moved on to the buckwheat pancakes. They were solid as well. To the best of my memory, the buckwheat flavor and vaguely bitter aftertaste were much more robust in these than in the Sqwire's buckwheat pancakes. Ultimately, I enjoyed both of my orders, and I can say that each was cooked perfectly. They were easy to cut and had no bu

First trip to the donut +dog and it was a special treat. I went on a Tuesday morning after trying to the weekend prior (the line was to the sidewalk and I didn't feel like waiting). This place does get busy on the weekend, because it's good, so be prepared for a wait if you go once the college kids and hungover tourists start rolling out of bed.

I got the South Beach Diet donut and the Hangover Burger. 

The donut was big, cream filled and also had a little bit of rum infused into it, which was fun. The donut flavor was a little too tart for me, it might have been blackberries or some other fruit used in the frosting.

The burger was the star of the show. It is served with 2 patties, cheese, bacon, a fried egg (over easy) on a maple donut as the buns. I don't think I've ever actually had a burger on a donut before, although I've dreamed about it a few times, and it was worth however many calories it was. The egg was a little runny for my liking, the whites didn't feel fully firm, but I'm sure next time I can ask for it over medium or hard. The burger does not come with fries, it's an additional cost.

Price was a little steep in my opinion. For the burger  (with no fries), a donut, tax and tip it came out to just over $20 which I feel is a little tough to justify for breakfast for one person.

I visited Zaytoon for the first time this weekend and can't stop thinking about how delicious it was!! I am a huge fan of Lebanese food as I am middle eastern. I have tried the most authentic of restaurants and this is definitely one of them! Their food is super good, with the freshest ingredients. Luckily we were able to find a reservation 1 day in advance and were seated immediately. I can't wait till the next time I'm in Santa Barbara to eat here again!

Service was honestly horrible. Our server sucked, she walked past our table twice and didn't ask if I wanted a refill when my cup was CLEARLY empty. (she did not get a tip) I ordered my eggs sunny side up, and they were basically raw, I had to send them back to be cooked and they came back still slimy. Went to the front to pay and split our check and an employee was up there, I politely said "hi" and she said "hi" in a rude tone and walked away. Won't be returning ‍

So good! The thin crust was so tasty, as greasy as I like my pizza to be and so much of it! I love huge slices. The only thing I would change is I would add more pepperoni, I don't think I had enough. The thick crust was tasty and super filling, I love the sauce! The garlic knots are packed full of garlic flavor. Overall, great place.

Fine Dining lives up to its name. The servers were very attentive, and all the dishes have a fancy look. We should have had a better research of the menu, because we realized maybe a bit too late that all the items on "future" section are vegan, and in smaller portion. For meat lovers, "classic" would be a much sensible choice. The signature pot flower cake was so beautiful and delicious! Generally, I would recommend it for brunch or afternoon tea. You would find yourself in wrong place, if you're looking for a lavish dinner.

I did like the food. All of it, but the description for what we ordered and what we received didn't match. I certainly appreciate the food and the service. Just need a little refresher on their menu items.

Worst Asian food ever. Had beef and broccoli. Had to spit out every piece of beef since I couldn't chew it. I'm afraid to think what type of meat it was. Very little sauce and small portions. Go anywhere else.

The pulled beef enchilada had tons of flavor. The Chile Relleno was very large. Most restaurants give you half a pepper but not these guys. You get the whole pepper. The chips were light and crisp. Can't believe I waited so long to try this place. Great service as well.

Incredible food! The service needs a little work, but we got our food relatively on time and it was worth the wait. The wait is the only reason I didn't give it a full 5 stars. The recent hype might cause some curious visitors to trek to south Tucson to find this treasure. The BBQ pork sticky buns are to die for...even their fried rice is just out of this world! Again, if they get a little busy the wait might get annoying. Great food for kids, too! (P.S. They do tell you it's a 20-min wait for dim sum orders)

Yuck! Oysters looked dirty, old and just disgusting. Drinks taste like juice with little or no alcohol in them. And the entrees?!! Better off going to fast food restaurant... snapper was dry, rice looked and tasted like minuteman rice and clam linguine was dry and flavorless. All you really pay for is the view. Save your money and go elsewhere!

I can remember this structure when it was a nicely appointed & interesting TGIFridays, then the Brown Boxer, & now Duff's.  It's as austere a dining room now as I can imagine.

We came for an early Friday night dinner with our 6 & 8 year old granddaughters.  I thought they'd enjoy the buffet concept.  I can't recall seeing so many LARGE people, most of them surprisingly senagers.

I tried the fried Chicken (decent piece of white meat), a Pork rib (left far too long in the oven [hard]), 3 breaded fantail shrimp (right out of the freezer box), a tiny square of breaded fish (flakey but no taste), & a bread stick (not bad with butter).  

Senior dinners on Fridays, Saturdays, & Sundays are $13.29 pp & children 3-11 $7.99.  Our total tab for the four of us came to $50.43 with tax.  We decided that we would not be returning based on the quality of the food, pricing (for what we received), & the arduous task of maneuvering oneself through & between all of the LARGE & AGILITY-CHALLENGED diners.

The atmosphere is so soothing and the decor is inviting. The portions on some of these dishes is insane. You could even share the pad thai to make room for more mimosas! The mimosas are definitely worth it, so make sure you give them a shot since they're adult candy! The owner is very personable and will even greet you if you come back even once. I will be keep coming back!

I had asked for a chicken sandwich with cheese and they forgot to put it on there so I asked if they can make me a new one and he was like yeah no problem but he first said can I just give u the cheese and I was like no I would like a new one . He like it will be faster if I just give you the cheese so that what he did And this was the manger tel me this . I will never come back to this one if that manger is working

This place is fantastic! I got a 14 inch pie to go that was almost too big to fit in the box for under $12, and managed to shovel 2 slices down before it even made it home. The cheese was perfect, the sauce was flavorful and the crust was nice and crispy. I moved to Florida 13 years ago from NY and have been on the search ever since for pizza that at least comes close to what I grew up with. Mirro's has exceeded my expectations. It tastes like home.
Got takeout for the first time trying out their seafood. Honestly I think it's good although I prefer the sauce to be more flavorful. Will return.

This restaurant has consistently good food but the service and delivery are not well managed. I'm currently waiting in the drive through line to pick up my order and there's no express for online pick up orders. The traffic is backed up onto the highway and I've been in line for 25 minutes. I'm watching the man ahead of me place his order. The last time I was here the wait to have my order brought to the car was over thirty minutes because the server couldn't find the order. The only reason I waited so long was because it was already paid. 

If you want an excessive wait for average fast food, this is the place. I'm still waiting and still had enough time to post a review.
This new management made all the food worse. I will never go back. All their food is different and now the same. Honestly, don't ever go!!

I only have two words for this place. Server Kevin. Wow. I mean I had the cannoli and it was AMAZING. But the real dessert was HIM. WOW.  The moment he flashed his crooked smile... game OVER! When I looked at those blue eyes (some could say they are green) I melted like ice cream. It was excellent service since the moment we stepped in. The beautiful hostess, I believe she said her name was Hannah, gave us elite service. Everything about this place went above and beyond, especially our naughty little opossum, KEVIN. What a treat. What a catch. Mmmmmm. Next time you're in Gulfport do us a favor and stop at Pia's! You will not regret it! And of course take a sweet little bite out of server Kevin.

I visit every Mellow Mushroom I can and absolutely love their restaurants so it pains me to say this place is a pretty sorry representation of what they offer. Before you even enter it's obvious what you're getting into. The doors are blacked out like a dive bar and the only indication of which door is the main entrance is a paper sign asking you to "use the other door." Next to the main entrance is a second sign indicating they validate parking for the garage next door with "1 hour" scratched over the words "2 hour." We walked into the empty restaurant and were greeted only by another sign indicating they were hiring for every single position. The place has apparently been open for years, but our waitress told us she had only been there a week and she appeared to be the only employee. She was nice, but didn't seem to know the menu. 

The building had the feel of a crumbling roller rink and the 80's music playing over the tired sound system only added to that ambiance. Mellow Mushroom is known for its creative decor so this was pretty disappointing. Despite the desolate state of the place the food was surprisingly delicious, but the prices were noticeably higher than other Mellow Mushroom locations. I assume the higher prices may just be because this location is in an inexplicably more expensive area of town. I'll level with you, just go to Five Points pizza. It's the best pizza place in town. My suggestion for this business would be to relocate directly  across the street fr

Oh.... Fork....  yeah.....
I really like this place. Killer bar!!! Great food! Great staff.  
Everyone at fork is so nice and helpful and attentive. Top marks for the staff. 
Ambiance is good and they have a great bar area.
Food is really good featuring local dishes, and they're very well done. Really well done.
I've eaten here a number of times and have never had a bad experience.
If you want to take someone you love out for a meal. Perfect 
If you want to take visiting in-laws out for a nice time, ... again Perfect.
If you want to have a nice lunch and a Midday Martini....  yup. You guessed it. Perfect.
Everything at Fork is really really good. Excellent in fact.
This is one of the best restaurants in Boise. Be sure to make reservations because it's not a huge place.

Go and fork yourself and the ones you love. You won't be disappointed

I'm originally from Louisiana and lived in Austin, TX for 16 years and have eaten at BBQ joints all over Central Texas. My Half Liter experience was solid overall but they miss the mark in a few key areas. They're new, so I'm willing to give them that and not hold it against them. The service more than made up for the nitpicky things that I noticed. 

My wife and I went to Half Liter for lunch today. I had the pulled pork sandwich w/ cole slaw, she had the pulled chicken sandwich w/ collard greens, and we split a side of burnt ends. 

I really enjoyed the pulled pork. It was a generous serving and was well seasoned with a bit of smokiness. The cole slaw was run of the mill but wasn't overly sweet. I ordered it because I like cole slaw on my BBQ sandwiches to add a bit of acid. The pickles on the side were tangy with a good snap to them. My wife said the chicken was good as well. Both were juicy and not dried out. Her collard greens were well seasoned without being too sweet. She also remarked that they weren't cooked to death like you find at most places. I found the prices to be more reasonable for a BBQ establishment and at $10, the Pick-a-Meat Sandwiches are the best deal on the menu. The mustard-based Carolina BBQ sauce is the best of the 3 sauces they have available with the Texas Hot Sauce that comes with the burnt ends a strong second place finisher.

The burnt ends were dry and flavorless. I thought they'd be a good barometer for the brisket (which is why I ordered th

Terrible experience, I love the fruit and yogurt parfait but have a strawberry allergy... they have always been very kind and made mine with no berries... I went today to order my usual and the woman taking my order told me they do not make them that way, that they come pre-made... I made her aware of my allergy and that they have always made them for me and she refused and told me it wasn't happening...needless to say I left without ordering

Was told a table would be a 10 min wait.  Waited 30+ and were told they were out of high chairs, great news when eating with a 16 month old.... Leaving we walked by a stack of 7-8 high chairs.
The waitress was upfront and said some items were taking longer than usual, and the only thing out fast would be fries.  Ordered fried for the kid and my wife and I waited 45 min for a burnt burger and a soggy chicken sandwich.  The fries were the only good part of either meal, and even they were over-salted.
2 stars because I'm giving them the benefit of the doubt that they are still working through some growing pains from just opening a few weeks ago.
In the meantime get an enjoyable meal at a different restaurant.

This place is NOTHING like the one in Murfreesboro. It's more like a taco bell or McDonalds then steak and shake. The cook was wearing a face mask and what I can only assume was the manager was coughing at the counter as she handed my boyfriend and I our cups. Unlike the real steak and shake, we had to wait and get our own food and it didn't even taste the same. The burger was plain and flavorless and half the fries were too crispy to even chew. I went cause I was hungry but honestly other than location, none of it was worth it. Go to Murfreesboro before coming here

Such a disappointing lunch and experience. We came for lunch and were craving a good steak. The service was so bad, never offered water (had to ask for it) and server never asked us if we wanted more drinks. We overpaid for mediocre food and stereotyped by the staff. When my fiancé and his daughter went to use the restroom before leaving the host ran to the bar to confirm we had paid. I had suspected the bad service was due to how we looked but that confirmed it for us. Steak was not cooked at the right temperature and the cuts were not worth the price.

I tipped at 15 percent because i always feel bad not tipping but my fiancé said i should have left nothing. This place was awful and i hope they learn how to treat better for the prices they charge.
Good quality food. Tasteful deco. Very clean restaurant. Nice portions. We will definitely be back.

This is an old school example of fine service and glorious food in the heart of party frenzied French Quarter.  An oasis of gentility.  Jared and Kevin, our servers were professional, courteous and kind.  If you are looking for the best of New Orleans, this would be a good stop.
neat atmosphere, average bbq food, small portions and I found the prices high, no lunch specials here, founded in Florida

The Zuzu Burger is honestly one of the best burgers in Philly. The other items on the menu have always satisfied.  Whether it is a quick pizza, sandwich, salad, or onion rings and fries - they tend to knock it out of the park.

On top of that, they have shown great respect for cleanliness and social distancing guidelines during the pandemic.

A true gem to have in the neighborhood - you won't be disappointed!

My husband and I came to House of Chen this past Friday to do pick up for dinner. It was busy, but Mr. Chen was quick and efficient as always.
We got general tso's chicken- husband said it's the best and ate it all.
Mongolian beef- melts in your mouth.
Sesame chicken- impeccably delicious.
Chicken fried rice- not dry and very tasty.
Fried chicken wings- the bomb.
Crab Rangoon- not our favorite, but my mom enjoyed it.
Shrimp lo mein- delish.
We love this place. Thank you for making delicious food and wearing your masks.

I have to say I am pleasantly surprised; great food.  This was my first visit they took the time to explain their process and the menu.  Seaweed salad, awesome.  Oversized serving,  great ice tea. I will definitely make this one of my favorites to go back!!

I went there last evening.  The environment was nice. The food was great.  Such a small world. Ends up I knew the owner from another resturant he owned. So happy to see him prosper.  I will so be back.
Our favorite go to sushi. Close to home. Good service. Nice selection of cooked sushi. Fair prices. Always busy.

Ordered through Uber eats, got my order 100% correct (that's rare nowadays), fast delivery, inexpensive and delicious. Was accommodating when I called in to make an order adjustment. I'll keep ordering.

Boyfriend liked the build his own breakfast. I thought the place took a little bit of a long times I got the blueberry cornmeal pancakes and honestly while a great portion I kind of just tasted the cooked/burnt part of it. Place is cute, people are nice and I really enjoyed the peanut butter milkshake !

We were so excited to finally try this restaurant. I ordered the "Stoney panini big cheese solo". Took my first bite and noticed a taste of pesto and dry bread, opened up the sandwich to see this. Very disappointed about laziness in making this sandwich.

Sandwich was good. I got the pork. However, the French fries with wiz was very disappointing. For 7$ I received a total of 13 fries. That is more than 50 cents per French fry... Definitely not worth it

Looking at the reviews, I should have known this would be a crappy food alert of an experience. 
Popeyes used to be good, this one in particular. Stopped in on my way home from work and went through the drive-thru. I orders the #5 spicey, 3 wings, your choice of sides and a drink. I chose the Cajun beans and rice for my side and also threw in an order of Cajun fries.
First off, there was about 8-10 fries in the fry bag....for $2.09 all I get is 8-10 fries....what a joke!!
Secondly....the wings were smaller than most pigeons....they probably were pigeaons!!
Lastly....there were no plastic ware to eat the beans and rice, I had to use my biscuit to eat those. Plus, there were no napkins in the bag. Just a bad experience....the young man at the DT window was not especially courteous....he didn't greet me....just took my money and handed me my order....I said thankyou and there was no response from him. And they want 15.00 an hour!! Please!!!!
You want real fried chicken and friendly service...go to Porters chicken about a mile down the road or go Gus's Memphis chicken in the heart of Maplewood....stay away from Popeyes....I doubt Whimpy would gladly pay you on Tuesday for a wing today!!! Blahhhhh!!!!

General Tso's pizza. Ok, I know these three words have been written numerous times by now, but it doesn't make them any less important.

I am all about the fusion life, but I'll admit I was unsure when I first heard of this spot. General Tso's is already Americanized Chinese food, so combining it with a pizza felt like it was bound for an extreme-- really good or really bad.

We went on a Saturday for lunch-- when we arrived at noon there wasn't anyone at the restaurant. However, by the time we left there were a good number of families, many of them Asian (always a good sign).

While Mei's might be known for their fusion pizza, they also have a full blown Chinese menu. On weekends, they also offer homemade dumplings which you can actually see them making in the restaurant.

Because I don't believe in either/or, our group ordered from both menus! We got the dumplings, chive box, zha jiang noodles, and three pizzas: teriyaki, mapo tofu, and of course, general tso's. The dumplings and chive box were yummy and the noodles perfectly cooked. But if you don't have the appetite for multiple dishes, I would have to say that you should try the general tso's pizza.

The pizza dough was amazing-- a little sweet and perfectly cooked. I'm not the biggest dough enthusiast, but I could've eaten the dough by itself. Alas, the cheese and general tso chicken added on top only enhanced the experience. A++

Service was fast and friendly and the food reasonably priced. This is an example of fusion

The Pad Thai was neon pink and smelled and tasted like a  Crayola Crayon. Fortunately, I was only able to eat one bite of it before I lost my appetite. Now you might be thinking, "What asshole orders Pad Thai at a Chinese restaurant?" Well now I know that you don't because it was absolutely rancid. 
The chicken fried rice was practically yellow rice soaked in cooking oil. How does a Chinese restaurant screw up such a simple dish? 
Save your time, money, and appetite by just going to Panda Express.

My first time having Greek food and I'm in love! Great atmosphere and cool design inside. I was with a big group of people so getting pictures of the food was near impossible, but everything was so amazing. We had the broiled octopus, the flaming cheese (opa), all different kinds of gyros, pita, and much more. Everything was cooked amazing and tasted so delicious. Only downside to the restaurant is it takes a little while to get your food and drinks due to it being such a popular and busy restaurant, but honestly everything is worth the wait. Can't wait to come back! 

Also love this place because I have a nut allergy and it is a nut free environment! Win win for me!

Explored the park with my pup and gf. Stopped at the Boathouse not knowing what to expect. Turned out to be a nice stop to grab a casual drink. Seated ourselves at an open table on the deck. They had a big fan going, a little bit noisy but much needed circulation. Ordered drinks at the bar. Nothing fancy. Lots of canned beers, a couple of premade stuff in pitchers, and basic cocktails. Didn't love my drinks since I am not into beer and the cocktails were meh, but prices weren't bad just to hang out in some shade and enjoy the view of the lake. There was a water bowl for dogs that I borrowed. Didn't seem like there was anyone bussing tables though. We didn't get any food but there table we sat by had a bunch of dirty dishes from previous people that just were never picked up the entire time we were there.

For pet owners: It looked like they allow pets on the rentals. I plan to take my dog out on the lake next time!

Oh my god. I just moved here and hadn't gone grocery shopping, so I decided to get some takeout from here even though it looked a bit pricy. I honestly think it was worth it. My boyfriend and I got the Quinn white pizza and added pepperoni, and I'm not joking, it was the best pizza I've ever had in my life. The crust was super caramelized and the pepperoni was almost crunchy, while the smoked gouda and ricotta tasted amazing. Although it was kind of expensive, my boyfriend and I only ate 4 out of the 6 slices (along with a side of really good waffle fries!) before we were full and satisfied. We ate the last two slices as a snack later along with the rest of the waffle fries. I'll definitely be getting again when I want a treat!

Bad experience here- found a hair in my food, and instead of apologizing and offering to replace the dish, they tried to convince us the hair was actually part of a banana leaf they cooked the dish in (it wasn't- it was a hair). They then brought the same dish back out and asked if we wanted it back. We didn't, and they reluctantly refunded us. The rest of the food was not great, and was overpriced. Would definitely not recommend, and will not be returning.

It's easy to drive by D & H but it is definitely worth the stop. The atmosphere is chill and welcoming for a good time. You can never go wrong with their jerk bbq wings, they are the best you'll ever have. They also host great DJs and bands that you won't want to miss, especially Thursday nights! If you're looking for a good happy hour spot, you've found it. Great prices on drinks and 10/10 Jamaican food.
peg's glorified skillets are  a must have in Reno. My personal favorite is the Huevos Rancheros.

Again, this place never disappoints! Great for getting a casual drink and watching a game. They have a big TV made up of 4 other TVs! Try the shot for slammer, it's a beer with a grapefruit shot in it!

This was my family's first time here. Great atmosphere the menu looked good. And then " bam" bad luck started. We patiently waited 20mins for a waiter. Then finally a little after an hr we got our apps. Then after another 30 we finally got our food. I was gonna leave a bad review. But Tyson the manager came over and explained due to a storm that happened in the am a computer problem stopped our food order from going to the cooks. And that they have been having problems all day.  He was nice, courteous owned the problem and even compt our meal!!!!!.  
Now for the food.  It was great! My grouper was fresh. And the food that my family ordered looked great. My son got the burger of the month which was basically a pizza on an Italian role with a burger inside!!! 
  We will definitely be back.

yummy, but slightly overpriced. the bottomless pita is hard to beat, and the coffee is so strong and good. vegetarian options are somewhat limited. falafel is mid. chicken shawarma is delish, according to my father. recommend if you'd like a fun environment and unique cuisine
Certainly off the beaten path.  I'd give it 3 starts due to the very bready poboys.  My family however loved it, so must give it 4. Roast beef poboy was good.

Was hesitant to go here because of the under 4 star reviews overall. But we were staying at the hotel and our kids love chicken fried rice. 

We have been here twice in the past two weeks. Have been visiting from the Bay Area and loved it so much we came back. We absolutely love the spicy garlic chicken dish (one of the best we've had!), chicken fried rice and the GSR roll. 
The dishes are not greasy at all like some establishments. Our server, Trey, was awesome. 

There will be a wait unless you get there a few minutes early to put your name in. 

Check it out, especially if you're staying at Grand Sierra Resort. You won't be disappointed.

We got here and the atmosphere is great dark woods and open air kitchen. The server was good and attentive. Love the appetizer of clams casino while my spouse had the caesar salad. For the entrees we had the bone in Rib eye and she had the lamb. Both were excellent choices. Well cooked and filling. Don't forget to ask about the sauces available they would have enhanced and good meal to great.
Fresh and healthy for a reasonable price. Tons of options all with quality ingredients.. the coffee is great too.

This location for Panera was a huge disappointment! I ordered the Mac & cheese broccoli soup. A bowel of it. 
Nothing like being on the run and then you were given a fork to eat your soup with! What a waste of money since I'll still have to wait until I Get home to eat this since soup is eaten with a spoon not a fork. People should slow down and pay attention. Don't mind paying $9.15 for a soup if I'm able to eat it when expecting.
Smh

We stopped to get our tires fixed while passing through to Las Vegas, power went out so we came here and it was hands down the best thing to happen today. The staff is super friendly and accommodating! I said I was sticking to my keto diet so couldn't do bread, they made me a delicious scramble with everything in it and it was perfect! For the service and quality of food, you will be stealing from them with their prices! I would absolutely come here again and suggest you come here as well. My travel companions who did have the bagels, said they were equally as delicious. I also enjoyed some iced coffee which was much needed after the long first leg of our trip. 10/10

Some of the best sushi in cherry hill.   The fried rice is so flavorful with large shrimp you can't go wrong.   My favorite appetizer is the tuna dumpling which I didn't get this trip but it is wonderful - crab and avocado mixed together and wrapped in a thin layer of tuna in the shape of a chocolate kiss     The sushi is fresh and of course made to order.   Service is usually fast and efficient.   My only complaint tonight was a piece of shell in the lobster roll which I have never had happen before.
Great food. Cool atmosphere. Great service! Only serve beer and wine, which I wasn't expecting but they have a fantastic sangria that I felt the effects of with just one glass!

If you are considering coming here. STOP  what you are doing, drive over here, and gets some pizza  

I love this place. From the New York street signs to the wine bottle lights. The thin crust pizza was to die for. We went with the waitress recommendations and the pizza we had was so delicious. I can't wait to go back. 

Oh and if it's your first time you get a free dessert. Now I don't expect everyone to believe me but I hate cheesecake. I haven't ever liked it. This cheesecake though, wasn't terrible, coming from me you wouldn't believe it. If you asked my partner in crime whose favorite dessert is cheesecake he said it was excellent. Turns out they make them all in house. 

Honestly the best pizza in town if you are into thin. Rust.

Just returned from eating lunch at Rasa.  The buffet is back on the weekends.  We were a little unsure how that would be handled but were delighted to find out we could still serve ourselves by wearing our masks and wearing plastic gloves provided at the start of the buffet line. The food was delicious. Both my wife, who is vegetarian, and I had plenty of options to enjoy.  The staff was very friendly and serviced our table frequently. We will definitely return on a regular basis.

Honestly I feel like giving a four. I got the sushi and couldn't eat it till I got home so it was not as good as it would have been if we would have sat in restaurant like normal. That is not the restaurants fault. Maybe don't get the fried ones till coronavirus is over. I couldn't really remember all the one's I got. I got Godzilla which is salmon, yellow tail, spicy sauce, and teriyaki. I didn't like that one as it was kind of bland and fried which isn't good for take home. I got Dobby which my daughter normally loves but she is every bite was either just rice or just crab as they didn't distribute the ingredients right. Bummer that is her favorite and she asked to go just for that. Macho which is jalapeno, shrimp, cream cheese, white onion, and avocado which was very good. Tsunami which is spicy crab, avocado, and cilantro. Very good. The other two I can't remember. Sorry. This trip was so so.

Clean- simple, big windows , good pizza! I particularly liked the size, individual! Very good salad- I am a big fan of a abundant, fresh and green salad! Tasty, healthy greenery with a pizza out of the oven!
Delicious housemade gelato! Basil flavor! Great paired with chocolate! If my next good friend comes and visit I take them here! I recommend SPUNTINO in style

Tinker Street is one of those special spots that you notice and immediately add to your bucket list. From the road, it looks like a tiny house, completely lit up with twinkle lights. It's swanky, humble and cozy, all at the same time. 

They weren't open yet, but we were still able to get a reservation on Yelp without having to call, which was incredibly convenient. Good to know for the future! When they did open later that day, the host called to confirm the reservation which was nice. 

We showed up and got sat on the covered patio (it's still plenty warm in the winter-- complete with full heat and blankets). I loved the twinkle lights out there, but the only reason I knocked off a star was that the tables were SO close together that I could hear the conversations on either side of me more than I could hear my husband (I almost couldnt hear him and we're still young). We were also up against the hostess stand and kept leaning so servers could even get through the tables. 

The food though? The food is incredible and great quality. I got the Great Lakes Walleye, something I would never get usually. I knew that if anyone could make it well, Tinker could, so I tried walleye for the first time. They put the fish on a plate of lentil beans that had been cooked in bacon, and had bits of apple around the dish; two things that I love. The walleye itself was cooked well and I ate every bite. 

They also had four local beers on tap, so I got a Big Lug ale to go with my meal and it's

I cannot tell you enough how amazing this sushi/hibachi/Japanese restaurant is! We have been coming here faithfully for about two years and recently have come weekly as regulars to have our favorite sushi rolls which include the out-of-control roll, the Mexican roll, the explosion roll etc. The possibilities are endless here at sushi Ushi and after visiting and dining here on a weekly basis, I can confidently say that no matter what you get, from the sushi bar or from the kitchen, is incredible. They are consistent with the freshness of the fish as well as the sushi rice consistency and flavor. It is always so delicious, always fresh and the service is always on point. There is not one night we come in that there aren't many families trying to get a seat in this 12 table restaurant. We love that every time we come here it may be  different people and a different chef or sushi chef but the results are always excellent and this last time we visited, tonight, it was my birthday. Nothing formal was announced to our server but she paid attention to all of the details and surprised me with an amazingly authentic dessert to celebrate!!!!! It was the kindest gesture and really meant more than she knows to have a restaurant and staff become more like friends and family. My husband looked over at me and said this is why he comes these excellent restaurants instead of Chain establishments. We are so impressed with Sushi Ushi every time and recommend that everyone comes to enjoy the BEST

Nomad Italian is how they bill themself and it's no joke. Our waiter is definitely a Nomad who has traveled everywhere else besides our table since I requested the check 30 minutes ago. I usually have a great experience here but to be frank the service has been atrocious today.

After a long week, a girl friend and I decided to hit up Columbia and end the week with conversations by the water. 

Our server was very friendly and attentive and the food all came out fast. The palomillo steak was flavorful (just a tad over done and smothered with way much onions) but other wise tasty. We ended the night with coffee and dessert. The bread pudding was very tasty and rich, definitely best shared!  The view that came with the meal was also wonderful, make sure to get seated outside!

My wife and I received a gift card and stopped in before the Pacers game.  We were sat promptly and greeted immediately.  We ordered some drinks, the Firecracker Shrimp (OUTSTANDING), I got the Mahi Mahi Tacos and the wife got the filet medallions.  Everything was spot on perfect.  The food was so damn good.  I ended up eating some of my wife's steak and it rivaled St Elmo's in quality and flavor(I'm not kidding).  My tacos were bursting at the seems with Mahi Mahi.  Our server Emily was also spectacular at her job.  She was friendly, attentive and made us feel welcomed.  This is one of the best experiences I've had in a very long time.  Kudos to your team from the FOH to the BOH and the bar, they made our experience top notch.

My wife looked this place up while we were in town. Stopped at the unassuming strip mall suite with the family and we got 3 burritos and a set of carne asada tacos. 

They've all the typical things for your tortilla/meat/cheese/veggie combo of choice. Mangos on the taco were great. Habanero sauce had just enough bite to make you question choosing it, but my wife still enjoyed it. I personally had the tomatillo/jalapeno salsa and it was great. 

Will definitely stop here again if we are in the area. 5/5 for sure.
Went for lunch on 6/16/20 and had a great overall experience. The drinks were cold, the food hot and the service outstanding!!!

The Bloody Mary is to die for best ever so yummy we ordered the southwest slinger and a avocado salad 
This place is a dive small business owner but with a Big Bang when it comes to the food
Gives a small town feel to a big city around you
Nice friendly staff and quick service
Came on a Tuesday morning and the place is packed at 10am
What a find for sure
If your in the area give it a try

On vacation in Tucson and we just happened upon this quirky, looks like a submarine restaurant! The host, and servers were very friendly and the food spectacular and unusual! The chips and white bean guerita were terrific and the la Tropical salad with coconut shrimp, dried cranberries, mango was very tasty! Lots of attention to details made it a very pleasant experience!
Amazing!!!! Excellent service, perfect Cuban with the right crisp in the bread. Didn't cut up my mouth and wasn't soggy. It was perfect! Pastelito was perfect. Will be a regular here for sure!

The quality and service isn't quite as good as before COVID, which is understandable, but I can't get over how much smaller the cheesecake slices have gotten. Each time they're a bit less, to now being half the size of the container they used to fill. Same price of course. Very disappointing.

There was one other table in the place and it took 10 minutes to get the waitress to help us. The food wasn't as ordered and it didn't all come out at the same time. The drinks were finally given to us as the food was being served. 

The place was dirty. One table had dirty plates all over it and it looked like someone spilled a drink on the floor under a table. Instead of cleaning it up they put a wet floor sign next to it. 

Very disappointed since Waffle House normally does good on service and food.

Delicious!  Stopped into this place on a whim and am very pleasantly surprised.  I'm sad that for a Brandonite I have overlooked it for so long.  The pizza is delicious, beer is cold and staff is friendly.  Will definitely come back!
Best fried chicken in Edmonton! I now live in the US and northern chicken is on point with the best down here. Great job guys can't wait to come back when I'm in town!
I love Thai food and this is one of the best establishments I have ever tried. The Panang was exceptional and my wife thought her Pad Thai was superb. Staff were friendly friendly and efficient

Pretty good.  Not a 5, but well worth a go.   Portions were good.  Use the gloves, very messy.   Tried three times to make a basic martini, but cant blame them much for that.   Service made up for any shortcomings.   Get what you pay for, bring your wallet!
Delicious everything!!!! Great ambiance, nice cocktails, wonderful service:) TJ is awesome!

Be sure to validate your bill BEFORE you leave the drive through.  After ordering a combo with juice on side & hot peppers on side, after getting home, I saw that I was charged over $11 for something that should have been about $7.50.  I called the restaurant, spoke with the manager, who told me that it was more because everything was wrapped separately & when you do that you get more beef than you would usually.  Not sure how, as a customer, I am supposed to know the beef quantity but the blame was of course, on the customer!

My first ever experience with Israeli cuisine. Only the mesibah (pre-fixe) menu was available, but it is what we would've chosen anyways. So many ingredients that I've never tasted before; it was definitely cool to experience flavors that my palate has never experienced before. If I'm lucky enough to ever return I could honestly be completely happy making a meal out of the hummus - it was the best hummus that I've ever had.
Tip: if you're having trouble getting a reservation, download the Resy app and choose any and all of your available dates and times and set up notifications. After trying unsuccessfully for weeks to get a reservation for the week that I would be in town I did this and received a notification at 3:30am for a canceled 730pm reservation. Without doing this I wouldn't have been able to experience this place. And, though I certainly did not appreciate being woken up at 3:30 in the morning, I was happy to not have missed out.
This is probably the best place to eat in China town. After the first minutes of confusion, it becomes a great experience.

WAITED 3 HOURS IN TAKEOUT LINE- didn't get food until 940 at night on Mother's Day. My mother didn't even get to eat dinner on Mother's Day.  Had a pick up time for 715, left a little early to be there on time just Incase.  Ended up waiting in a line that didn't move for 3 hours.  Called the restaurant numerous times per their instructions when pick up time was ready and NO ONE answered, not ONCE.  Was left not knowing if my food was ready, where I was in line, how long the delay was.  They should atleast had the decency to call the people with orders and told them they were running late and if they wanted to reschedule they could but no they couldn't even answer the phone.  Not only did I wait three hours in line on Mother's Day but my parents didn't get food being I didn't get to the front of the line until 940PM!!! Quarantine has been going on for well over a month, you can't tell me they didn't know how to plan and if they couldn't handle all those orders they should have had a cut off.  Who wants a day old lobster dinner when you pay 70 dollars for it fresh to have that night.  Had I known I wasn't getting my food until 940 at night and would have to sit in my car for three hours in line I would have never done it.  Also would have left the line but being they didn't answer I didn't know how much longer it would be and by that time was stuck on a one way road I couldn't get out regardless even if I wanted to.  Awful awful service, so disrespectful and distasteful and on

Went out to eat for the first time in forever due to covid and the service was great i felt like the did everything to keep up with precautions and our waitress's were really nice an Attentive... the food was good the only  complaint i could possibly have is they were out of bloody mary mix ... but the drink they brought instead more then made up for it .. we were happy will be back

This is arguably the absolutely best brunch I've ever had in my life. From the ambience to the amazing dishes, I can't stop raving about how incredible this place is. The caesar salad is anything but standard with kale and cauliflower. It was delicious!! If you are ever in New Orleans, Jack Rose is a must. I will definitely be back again and again. Lastly, huge kudos to our server, Justin. He was very attentive and courteous and made the visit that much more enjoyable.

Closed for good. Pulled in tonight after giving a second chance with no masks and knowing the main daytime guy took it seriously...and just a vacant building with no sign and wires hanging out where the cash register used to be. Odd because seems like the perfect plan for nowadays having no dining room, small space, always lots of activity.

Just stopped by here this morning. It's located right on Gallatin on the east side. There is lots of parking. The space is eclectic and funky in its decor, there's a space for live music (whenever that returns to our lives!). The staff are polite and informative, they walked me through the menus. The spiked milkshakes were intriguing but I'll need to come back for that. 
I got a mocha coffee, and 2 six packs. The itty donuts were prepared fresh after my order and were delicious! My favorite was the Boston creme and cinnamon sugar. Can't wait to visit again!

What a great addition to the neighborhood! Some standouts are the calamari, sausage orecchiette pasta, beets salad, cauliflower and the baklava for dessert (their family recipe). Ambiance is great for date night or girls night out and staff is super knowledgeable on the menu and wine list.

Had a Groupon. Since we are in the middle of a pandemic, we are NOT going inside anywhere. Restaurant would not make an accommodation to allow us to order take out. Groupon was also uncooperative. Totally irresponsible to those who choose not to be exposed to others by dining inside.

Great place to watch any sports game.  Menu is limited during Rays home games in main bar area but still great options.  Massive building and many options for seating for any crowd. All staff are always so welcoming here.
This place has the best Mexican food in the area by far. It's super authentic! I've dined in and picked up and my order is always ready to go. Would highly recommend.

My family and I decided to try Squeeze In for breakfast yesterday and it did not disappoint! My 4 year old had the teddy bear pancake and thought it was the funnest thing! I had the sweet potato bowl and it was wonderful. My husband had the lake taco with potatoes.  Everything was cooked perfectly and tasted great. The atmosphere is fun and laid back which made it great for our 1 year old.  We will definitely be back the next time we are in Reno. Would love to try their lunch.
Authentic Mexican food! I love their tacos, burritos and quesadillas. You can add any meat option to your order. I like the pollo, pastor and chorizo.
The bartender, Sarah, was amazing. Very accommodating with my husband wanting to sample a wine. Our charcuterie board was flawless. Highly recommend!

Lord have mercy I'm kicking myself in the butt for not reading the spot on reviews. Thank God the area opened a Chickfla because this operation is a joke and to blame here aren't the staff members but thier regional or area management which lacks quality control, crowd control and a long list of missed opportunities, coaching opportunities. Never again!

I love love love the food and drinks but since the new location the customer service has gone way down. More people to help and maybe with the same smaller staff because they tend to forget about you! So once you finally catch some one you have to place drink and food order at the same time and when they bring your food - make sure to order another drink if you think you ll need one because it will be tough to get someone once they ve left.

It was my first time trying Tostones. I have been wanting to try it for a while. Today, i ordered from Uber Eats. The Latin pork nachos were fab! However, they forgot to put the house sauce on top. I DID feel like it was missing something. This is why I gave it 4 stars. I wish I could have tried it my first time ...properly fixed.  ‍

If you're ~on a mission~ for a good little hipster taqueria....... 

Look no further than Mission Taqueria. 

This place is really good. The location is super chic/modern but homey at the same time. It's the perfect casual cool hangout, almost like if Urban Outfitters decided to add a taco bar to their stores. It has a completely different vibe than most places in Philly. 

The food is flavorful and there are a lot of interesting combinations on the menu. I tried the baby gem salad and nachos and they were both delicious. A little pricey, but delicious. The baby gem salad had smashed potatoes in it that added such an interesting little flair. A lot of the items are like that, with just a little extra zazz thrown in to keep things interesting. 

The service was also quick during lunch time. From my experience, the food and everyone working there was wonderful!

Great experience! After finding this gem on Yelp, we decided to try it out. There were no cars in front but who cares! Go in anyway! We did and I'm glad! Huge burgers, cold beer and great customer service!

Our waitress brought us our food, my husband ordered the endless mix and match, when we asked where his chicken strips were, our waitress said "oh those will be brought out after I put in the order for them, you cant use them as a meal for your child. You cant order food for yourself and give it to your child as a meal ". My daughter is 2 years old and doesnt eat her own food when we order something for her. She prefers to try what we are eating. I shouldn't have to explain or justify why my child likes to share with mommy and daddy. Will not be going back.
Micaela was great! She took great care of us. Margs were delicious. Thanks again. We stopped in for drinks and an app and got just what we were searching for.

Not impressed.   Ordered 3 piece meal   An 8 strip piece. One large mashed potato got a small cup filled half way and covered in gravy.  A large cole slaw. Again a small cup.     The chicken was ok. Don't care for hot spices on chicken.  The first piece had my nose running and mouth burning before I had even ate a half a piece.    The lack of large side was extremely disappointing as the two small cups had to be split.      The receipt is not itemized so you can verify your order.  Which is a good thing for the store. As they can deny all culpability.     Would I order from here again?   The corn fritters were good. And were actually plentiful.   But man can not live on corn fritters alone.    So no.  I am continuing in my search for southern fried chicken.  This place is not it.   It is  comparable to All the other fast food chicken places.     28 bucks later time to go find something to eat.
To the sole fact that the hours are wrong on here like update that shit........................................

Good find in Croydon. Keep up the good work Sunrise Diner!

I was jonesing for a steak and also delivery as it was a bitterly cold night in late December. My choices were either Applebee's or Sunrise dinner, I typically always choose a new restaurant option and very glad that I found this diner.

Roast Prime Rib - Absolutely delicious! Ample amounts of flavor were cooked into this Prime Rib. I fed my new cat a tiny piece the day after and after he ate it he looked up at me that he found the holy grail to life, it was truly a magical moment shared.

French Onion Soup - Now this was the one star deduction, I chose the snapper soup as you can add any soup for only $1.99 and French Onion came instead (Assuming they were out of the Snapper but no phone call ahead to let me know). It was not bad by any means, a bit salty but that's how it goes with French Onion. 

Wisconsin Cheese Fries - A ton of fries with gooey cheese, bacon bits, and above average fries. I don't even recall tasting them the day they were ordered but if I snag another fry from a future order I will be sure to update review.

Pork Pot Stickers - Girlfriend ordered the pot stickers and said they were very good. Now these are lightly fried and I only order steamed but if your a fan of pot stickers and don't mind lightly fried I suggest you give it a try.

Inconsistent.  I'm giving this Peets a 3 but if I could it would be 3.5. When it's good it's really good.  But 1 in three times my vanilla latte tastes burnt or they put too much vanilla in it or I've asked for oat milk but it tastes like whole milk.@?! The people used to be more friendly but I'm giving grace for that -- we are all COVID tired and I think the morning shift often gets slammed with online deliveries.

This is only the second bakery I have visited where I have been impressed with the service, quality and where every item is delicious! The other one is in Portland Maine, so unless you're going on a trip this should be your only bakery you visit in the city. The absolute best gigantic chocolate chip cookies and the apple puff tart is a flaky buttery sin. I hate frittatas, but their take on the classic is to die for. This is a Nashville - must!
First time visit to Boise and this was in our list of local faves to try and it didn't disappoint!  I had the Arkansas biscuits and Gravy.... really really good.... highly recommend
You're doing a fantastic job.  Hot food. Fresh ingredients. Cooks who care.  Fast delivery.  Keep up the great work!!!

Really disappointing first time experience. Overall it was over priced and the majority of our food was not good. It's disappointing since they have so many glowing reviews and have gotten good press. Both my wife and kids had their chicken strips and they were absolutely dry and not hot. Clearly they were re-warmed. I had a quarter of a bird Nashville Hot and it was freshly cooked. Not as spicy as I would like but it was fine. Sides were small. Corn bread was cold, over baked and dry. Mac and cheese was dry and not hot enough. Mashed potatoes were fine. 

Sorry to say it was just not enjoyable and I would have rather just gone to Chick Fil A.

Pretty poor effort from Sybergs today. The wrap was falling apart on the plate, one chicken strip when normally there's 2 or 3. Had to actively search for tomatoes and cheese. Luckily their sauce somewhat saved it. Fries undercooked as well. Ordered coffee that didn't show up until the meal was over and in a to go cup; waitress felt so bad she didn't charge us for it.
Been many times to several different locations, if it had been my first experience I would not be back.

My wife and I we here last Wednesday night for dinner. Our food was good and very plentiful, we were very impressed. We asked our waiter for some bread before the entrees came out and the bread never showed up. Also tried their fresh Italian sausage, out of this world.
